## 问题与改动 / Problem and change

说明触发场景以及改动后的行为。 / Describe the trigger and resulting behavior.

## 验证 / Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] 涉及桌面交互时运行 `npm run smoke` / Desktop smoke test when applicable

补充相关平台、样本与结果；不适用的检查请说明。检索改动需提供排序对照和规模测试结果。

Describe platforms, fixtures and results, or explain checks that do not apply. Search changes need ranking comparisons and scale measurements.

## 兼容与限制 / Compatibility and limitations

说明数据、缓存、隐私或格式支持的变化；仅使用可公开的测试资料。

Describe relevant data, cache, privacy or format changes. Use redistributable test documents only.
